description: This file contains implementations of masked tensor operations, including reductions, normalization, and element-wise operations, with support for sparse and dense tensor layouts in PyTorch.

methods.name: Callable[_P,_T] _apply_docstring_templates(func: Callable[_P, _T])
methods.description: Decorator that applies standard docstring templates to masking reduction/normalization functions.

methods.name: Tensor sum( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Performs masked summation, supporting dense and sparse tensors, with optional masking.

methods.name: Tensor prod( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Performs masked product reduction with support for dense and sparse tensors.

methods.name: Tensor cumsum( input: Tensor, dim: int, *, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes masked cumulative sum along a specified dimension.

methods.name: Tensor cumprod( input: Tensor, dim: int, *, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes masked cumulative product along a specified dimension.

methods.name: Tensor amax( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes masked maximum along a specified dimension with support for sparse tensors.

methods.name: Tensor amin( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes masked minimum along a specified dimension with support for sparse tensors.

methods.name: Tensor argmax( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: int | None = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Finds index of maximum value in a masked tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: Tensor argmin( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: int | None = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Finds index of minimum value in a masked tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: Tensor mean( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Calculates masked mean, supporting dense and sparse tensors, with output elements set to NaN if fully masked.

methods.name: Tensor median( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: int = -1, *, keepdim: bool = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes masked median with support for dense tensors; relevant when elements are not fully masked.

methods.name: Tensor logsumexp( input: Tensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Performs masked LogSumExp reduction on dense tensors.

methods.name: Tensor logaddexp( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, other: Tensor | MaskedTensor, *, dtype: DType | None = None, input_mask: Tensor | None = None, other_mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes masked element-wise logaddexp for dense tensors, considering explicit masks.

methods.name: Tensor norm( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, ord: float | None = 2.0, dim: DimOrDims = None, *, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes tensor norm with support for masking and sparse/dense layouts, with configurable order.

methods.name: Tensor var( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, unbiased: bool | None = None, *, correction: int | float | None = None, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Calculates masked variance with support for dense and sparse tensors.

methods.name: Tensor std( input: Tensor | MaskedTensor, dim: DimOrDims = None, unbiased: bool | None = None, *, correction: int | None = None, keepdim: bool | None = False, dtype: DType | None = None, mask: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Calculates masked standard deviation supporting dense and sparse tensors.

methods.description: Computes softmax with masking support for dense tensors.
